lina (Docs): Quick sync 1 min1: can we produce a tiny matrix mapping quant_profile -> expected throughput delta + risky model classes for the Optimize toolkit guide? Also need short migration snippets for SDK, CLI, and Terraform. Ideally a one-paragraph customer blurb.

ev an (Eng-runtime): I can do the matrix. Quick numbers from internal bench (A10): 4bit-compact ~1.6x tokens/s vs 8bit; 4bit-gamma ~1.9x; 2bit experimental ~2.8x but unstable. Latency tail can increase slightly on long sequences at 4bit-compact. I'll paste a CSV later.

tariq (ML): Important: list models we saw quality regressions on. In our tests instruction-tuned RLHF chat models had the highest sensitivity at 4-bit-compact. NLU tasks (embeddings and classification) were mostly fine. Recommend an explicit "run eval harness" line in the guide.

lina (Docs): Good call. For migration snippets we should show both the SDK and the CLI. Also we renamed the config key `batch_sz` -> `microbatch` in v0.13; call that out so infra folks don't miss it.

ev an (Eng-runtime): SDK snippet suggestion (v0.13):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
cli = RedwoodClient()
resp = cli.generate(model='rwd/ft-chat-7b', microbatch=4, quant_profile='4bit-compact')
print(resp.choices[0].text)
```
CLI snippet (redwoodctl):
```
redwoodctl deploy set-config --model rwd/ft-chat-7b --quant-profile 4bit-compact --microbatch 4
```
And a tiny YAML runtime example for ops docs: 
```yaml
service:
  model: rwd/ft-chat-7b
  quant_profile: "4bit-compact"
  microbatch: 4
  cache_prefix: true
```
Link to CLI docs will go in the PR.

tariq (ML): Add a short note: "If you require bit-identical outputs, don't switch profiles without re-evaluating your prompts. Pin quant_profile in Dedicated or set strict fallback policy in hosted routes."

ruth (Product): Can we also include a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb explaining why this change exists (cost/perf tradeoff) and a suggested rollout plan (canary -> broad)? I can help word it.

lina (Docs): Yes please. I'll draft the blurb. Plan: one FAQ entry, 2 code snippets, the perf matrix table, a short QA checklist, and the customer blurb. Target PR branch: docs/optkit/quant-profiles-matrix.

ops-bot: PR created: https://go.redwood/pr/3321 - checks: docs-lint, link-check, examples-run. :ci:

ev an (Eng-runtime): Small Terraform snippet to help infra teams (we renamed var `batch_sz` to `microbatch`):
```hcl
variable "microbatch" {
  type = number
  default = 4
}

resource "redwood_route" "api" {
  model = "rwd/ft-chat-7b"
  quant_profile = "4bit-compact"
  microbatch = var.microbatch
}
```

tariq (ML): Suggest adding a short test command in the examples folder: `examples/quick_eval.sh` that runs the eval harness on a small prompt set and outputs a pass/fail. Makes it easier for customers and SEs.

lina (Docs): I'll add a link to `examples/eval/quick_eval.sh` in the QA checklist. Also will note: Hosted may fallback to 8bit if kernel not available in that region and route policy allows fallback. Recommend policy snippet to force error on incompatible quant profile.

ev an (Eng-runtime): Policy snippet (example):
```yaml
route_policy:
  quant_enforce: "fail_if_unavailable"  # options: allow_fallback | fail_if_unavailable
```

ruth (Product): Approving the customer blurb draft next. Lina, ping me when the PR has the blurb and I'll add it to the weekly customer digest if everything looks good.

ops-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, link-check found one broken internal link -> ops runbook. (1/3 checks done)

lina (Docs): Noted broken link, will fix. ETA for PR merge: Friday midday after Tariq's smoke test.

tariq (ML): I'll run the smoke eval on a few instruction prompts tonight and paste a short summary here. Expect ~1.8x throughput for 4bit-gamma on our long-chat trace, but caveats noted for some chat-only LLMs.

lina (Docs): Thanks — when you paste the CSV perf table, I'll include it as a small Markdown table and add an inline caveat line.
